authorization: User authorized seen comparisons, one bounded Wessels witness-quantity experiment, and manuscript provenance/scope corrections on 2026-10-17
historical_data_access: The two public datasets and the original Step1 evaluation were previously examined. This is not independent prospective validation or third-party preregistration.

methods.B: original frozen effect_score and variance_score ridge risk
methods.R: seen2 before seen1 before seen0, then original risk_B, original protocol tie hash, canonical pair
methods.C: jointly fit effect_score, variance_score, I(seen=0), I(seen=2); seen1 is the fixed reference category
methods.C0: jointly fit effect_score, variance_score, missing_endpoints; exact S-minus-degree feature ablation
methods.S: original frozen effect_score, variance_score, missing_endpoints, inverse_degree ridge risk

seen_comparison.fitting: Original dataset-seed TRAIN-OOF records, total weight 1 per canonical pair then normalize sum to 1, weighted feature means/SD, zero SD replaced by 1, log1p(loss_mse/m) with global weighted median m floored at 1e-12, Gram+I ridge lambda 1, unpenalized intercept, no hyperparameter search
seen_comparison.coding_restriction: The seen1 reference category is fixed before new evaluation; reference coding is not selected based on results.

key_conditional_analysis.selection: reselect each rule inside seen1 with its own floor(0.5*n_seen1) equal quota; do not filter the original global accepted sets

seen_comparison.effect_control: Secondary S/C within fixed original TRAIN-OOF effect quartiles in all_queries, 50% per quartile and population-size stratum weighting. Empty strata carry zero weight; nonempty strata with zero quota make the replicate undefined.

bootstrap.cluster: canonical pair within dataset, carrying all original seed records
bootstrap.seen1: filter per-seed seen1 after mapping common full-dataset pair multiplicities
bootstrap.selection: exact floor quota recomputed at each bootstrap replicate, with duplicate multiplicities split only at quota boundary
bootstrap.aggregation: geometric mean of three seed-level selected mean-loss ratios
bootstrap.interval: pointwise percentile 95%; secondary outcomes are supporting analyses, not additional independent confirmations

seen_comparison.interpretation: Primary S/C and key seen1 S/C are distinct. Broad or null-spanning intervals are inconclusive, not evidence of equality. Do not change scorers, category coding, or thresholds to seek a favorable result.

wessels_witness_quantity.varied: available training-combination residual witness library; recompute selected-witness kernel fitting and transfer only

replay.failure_action: stop and investigate without modifying model parameters or scientific estimand

wessels_witness_quantity.aggregation: Within each seed average each query's loss over three subset orders, then average over queries; geometric mean of seed loss ratios rho_f relative to the fixed backbone; G_f=1-rho_f
wessels_witness_quantity.primary_contrast: Delta=G_1.0-G_0.25=rho_0.25-rho_1.0; positive means the full witness library improves residual gain compared with 25%

bootstrap.cluster: canonical pair carrying all seed/order/fraction records

wessels_witness_quantity.interpretation: A fixed-endpoint, fixed-hyperparameter component ablation. It is not a complete lower-experiment-budget retraining study, a cross-dataset density causal explanation, or independent biological replication.

budget.pilot: full-library replay and seed1/order1/25% before evaluation-label join
